# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

+# Pull Request Quality Checks Workflow
+#
+# Runs automated quality checks on every pull request to ensure code quality
+# before merging. Jobs run in parallel for faster feedback.
+#
+# Filtering (S2):
+# - Uses Turborepo --filter=[HEAD^1] to run only affected packages
+# - Remote caching via Vercel for shared artifacts across CI runs
+# - Full runs available via workflow_dispatch or 'ci:full' label
+#
+# Coverage Reporting (S3):
+# - Generates coverage reports during test job using Vitest coverage
+# - Posts coverage summary as sticky PR comment (updates on each push)
+# - Uploads HTML coverage report as artifact for detailed review
+# - Fails PR if coverage decreases from base branch
+#
+# Triggers: Pull requests to development and main branches, workflow_dispatch
+# Jobs: lint, type-check, test (with coverage), build (all parallel)
+#
+# Related Stories:
+# - Epic 1A.5.S1: Create PR Workflow with Quality Checks
+# - Epic 1A.5.S2: Configure Turborepo Filtering for CI
+# - Epic 1A.5.S3: Add Coverage Reporting to PRs
+#
+# Concurrency:
+# - Cancels in-progress runs when new commits are pushed to the same PR
+# - Prevents wasted CI minutes on superseded commits
+
+name: PR Quality Checks
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches:
+      - development
+      - main
+    # Don't skip docs changes - they might affect build or have code examples
+  # Allow manual trigger for full CI runs without filtering
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      full_run:
+        description: "Run full CI without filtering"
+        required: false
+        default: true
+        type: boolean
+
+# Cancel in-progress runs on the same PR to save CI minutes
+concurrency:
+  group: pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+# Environment variables for Vercel Remote Cache
+# TURBO_TOKEN and TURBO_TEAM must be configured as repository secrets
+env:
+  TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }}

+  TURBO_REMOTE_ONLY: true
+

+    timeout-minutes: 15

+        uses: actions/checkout@v4

+

comments.body:
_🧹 Nitpick_ | _🔵 Trivial_

**Suggest validation for numeric values from jq.**

Whilst the error handling for jq failures is good, consider validating that extracted values are numeric before passing to `bc`. If jq returns unexpected data, `bc` arithmetic could produce incorrect results.



Apply this pattern for defensive validation:

```diff
  if ! STATEMENTS=$(jq -r '.total.statements.pct // 0' "$file" 2>&1); then
    echo "Warning: Failed to parse coverage data in $file: $STATEMENTS" >&2
    continue
  fi
+ # Validate numeric value
+ if ! [[ "$STATEMENTS" =~ ^[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*$ ]]; then
+   echo "Warning: Non-numeric statements value in $file: $STATEMENTS" >&2
+   continue
```
